metadata.source: NYC DEP water service line inventory, NYC Open Data jqfp-uff7 ('Lead Service Line Location Coordinates'; DEP edition DEP25V11_202601), aggregated to 2020 census tracts (geometry from data/acs.geojson)
metadata.notes: Counts are tax lots (BBLs) by DEP's last known service-line material; one record per BBL, so multiple service lines on one lot count once. total_lines excludes 'Non-Applicable' lots (no operational service line), reported separately as not_applicable. Percentages use total_lines as denominator. small_sample = fewer than 25 lots (percentages unstable).
